title: Commercial shipping activity
scale: Log-scaled relative density; clipped at the positive-cell 99.5th percentile
method: Source hourly AIS position reports, including stationary vessels. Source overviews averaged to a display grid, reprojected to Web Mercator, then averaged for lower zoom levels. Color is a relative visual index, not a quantity of ships or cargo.
limits: Historical activity, not live vessel positions.
Generalized to a 4,096-pixel-wide world raster; do not interpret individual berths or vessels.
AIS coverage varies. Blank cells do not establish that no shipping occurred.
Activity is not specific to the material selected in OVERSHOOT.
